h1: Your Trusted Local Experts for Floor Demolition Services

blocks.text: Your Trusted Local Experts for Floor Demolition Services
We are the best in the town

items.title: Trusted by people of the Greater Toronto Area

c: Is worn-out, damaged flooring making your space look tired and outdated? What was once a beautiful, functional surface may now be cracked, uneven, or covered in layers of old materials that create tripping hazards and detract from your property’s potential. Over the years of use, even the highest-quality floors can become liabilities that compromise both safety and aesthetics.

One call to our team transforms your problematic floors into a clean, level base ready for new installations. We carefully assess your demolition floor plan to determine the most efficient removal strategy, accounting for factors like adhesive types, underlayment conditions, and subfloor protection needs. For concrete floor demolition projects, we use concrete breakers and dust control systems. Flooring removals involve specialized scrapers and containment methods, while wood floor demolition requires careful de-nailing and surface preparation.

blocks.text: Break Free from Damaged Flooring – Flooring Demolition Made Easy

c: That worn-out flooring isn’t repairing itself. What was once a smooth, attractive surface has become a patchwork of cracked tiles, warped boards, and stubborn adhesives. The materials are breaking apart, the underlayment is failing, and every day it remains makes your space look more dated.

We specialize in making problematic floors disappear quickly, safely, and affordably. Our professional floor demolition service starts at just {{cad_125}}, and we handle every step from pulling up the first layer to final cleanup of your subfloor.

We take care of all the tough work: carefully removing demolition tile floor layers, extracting stubborn adhesives, eliminating every last nail and staple, and hauling away all debris. For concrete floor demolition, we use specialized equipment to break up and remove slabs efficiently.
Ready to reclaim your space? Call us at +1 647 922 5865 or book online.

blocks.text: Same-Day Flooring Demolition Service in Your Neighborhood

c: That outdated flooring isn’t just unattractive, it’s a potential safety hazard many homeowners underestimate. Proper floor demolition involves far more than simply pulling up tiles or planks, with hidden challenges like stubborn adhesives, uneven subfloors, and hazardous materials lurking beneath the surface.

Our professional flooring demolition team eliminates these risks by managing every aspect of your project. Whether you’re preparing for a beautiful new floor installation, eliminating tripping hazards, or simply tired of living with damaged surfaces, we offer same-day and next-day demolition services throughout the area. Our experienced crews handle all types of flooring demolition with specialized equipment and techniques to protect your subfloor while completely clearing the way for your renovation.
Our Fully Equipped Crew Arrives With:

items: Specialized scrapers and floor strippers for efficient material removal
Concrete breakers and grinding equipment for slab demolition

Protective gear to handle sharp debris and adhesives

blocks.text: How Our Flooring Demolition Services Work

c: Our Efficient Process Delivers Perfect Results

items: Our professional team specializes in floor demolition for all property types, from small bathroom tile removal to large commercial concrete slab demolition. Our experienced crew carefully executes each project using specialized tools and techniques to protect your subfloor while efficiently demolishing all flooring materials.
From single-room wood floor demolition to entire-home tile floor demolition, we handle every aspect with expert precision.

c: At Live Junk Free, we don’t just demolish floors – we demolish them responsibly:

items: All tile, wood, and laminate materials are sorted for proper recycling
Concrete flooring is crushed and repurposed for construction aggregate
Metal fasteners and hardware are processed at certified recycling centers
Usable materials are donated to community projects when possible

items.q: Do you remove all types of flooring, including tile, hardwood, and carpet?
a: Yes, we professionally remove all flooring types, including ceramic tile, natural stone, hardwood, laminate, vinyl, carpet, and concrete floors. Our team is equipped to handle any material or adhesive type.

items.q: How much does flooring demolition cost?
a: Our flooring demolition services depend on the area, with final pricing depending on the material type, adhesive difficulty, and subfloor condition. We provide free, no-obligation estimates.

items.q: What areas do you serve for flooring removal?
a: We serve homeowners and businesses across Bradford, Port Perry, Pickering, Richmond Hill, Scarborough, Schomberg, Mississauga, Newmarket, and throughout the Greater Toronto Area.

items.q: Do I need to prepare the area before demolition?
a: No preparation is needed – our crew handles everything from furniture moving to final cleanup. We recommend removing small valuables and fragile items as a precaution.
